text.tspan: Paper first, then check: the three parts of this lab
ip route get: local or remote?
can two sets of /24s be summarised?
subnet_check.py (in files/lab-02.1) uses only Python's standard ipaddress module · ipcalc is optional (brew install ipcalc on a Mac)
